Ingredients: refined deodorized sunflower oil, water, sugar, emulsifier (modified corn starch), salt, powdered eggs, acidity regulator (citric acid), stabilizer (guar gum), acidity regulator (acetic acid), preservative (potassium sorbate), mustard flavour, natural black pepper flavour, natural colourant (beta-carotene). May contain traces of mustard, gluten and dairy products. Minimum shelf life at the temperature from 0°C to +25°C - 120 days. Date of minimum shelf life (Best before) is the lot number (L) and is indicated on the side seam of the packet. The shelf life of mayonnaise after opening the packaging is 14 days at the temperature from 0°C to +11°C inclusive, within the total minimum shelf life. Store at the temperature from 0°C to +25°C and relative humidity not exceeding 75%. Mayonnaise should not be stored together with products that have a pungent specific odour or in direct sunlight.
Net weight: 500 g permissible negative deviation 3%.
Nutritional value per 100 g of product: energy value – 2535 kJ / 616 kcal; fats – 67 g, of which saturated fat – 9,5 g; carbohydrates – 3,2 g, of which sugar – 2 g; protein – 0,1 g; salt – 0,96 g.
